name: Ga deo Le
summary: Gà đèo Le is free-range mountain chicken from Quế Sơn, boiled with crushed purple shallot and eaten with rau răm and sliced lime leaf.
origin: Đèo Le, Quế Sơn. In Da Nang it is a specialty to seek.
howToEat: The chicken is boiled with crushed purple shallot and eaten with rau răm and sliced lime leaf.
It is served whole, wings spread in the shape called cánh tiên.
seoTitle: Ga deo Le — chicken from Que Son
seoDescription: Gà đèo Le is free-range chicken from Quế Sơn, boiled with purple shallot, rau răm, and lime leaf.
